data.name: Harbans
data.gender_notes: Harbans is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Harbans is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Har' meaning God and 'Bans' meaning bounty or riches. The name is believed to bestow the blessings of God upon the bearer. The name Harbans carries the meaning “God's Bounty” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harbans usually hope their child will grow to embody god's bounty and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harbans total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
